title: "Fix-It-For-Me" AI Pull Requests
goal: Expand the Remediation Advisor to automatically generate verified code patches and submit them as Pull Requests to GitHub/GitLab when a vulnerability is found.
scope: Backend integration, Remediation Advisor prompt engineering, and UI for 'Generate PR' button in Findings Theater.
generation_reason: To provide 'Machine-Speed Remediation' and stay ahead of offensive AI capabilities like Mythos.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Ensure PRs are clearly marked as AI-generated and require human review. No direct commits to main branch.

success_criteria: OAuth integration with GitHub/GitLab is functional.
AI successfully maps finding to a code patch and pushes a branch.

acceptance_criteria: Tests verify API communication with mocked Git providers.
